neighbours.label: small classes / low student-teacher ratio giving close personal attention (school marketing)
fire: Because our classes are small, teachers know every student by name.
A low student-to-faculty ratio means more one-on-one time with professors.
With only twelve pupils per class, each child receives personal attention.
Our seminars are kept small so that everyone can take part in discussion.
Small class sizes let instructors give detailed feedback on every essay.
The academy limits each course to fifteen students for closer mentoring.
Students enjoy close contact with faculty thanks to our small groups.
At a small college you can build real relationships with your teachers.
quiet: Because our campus is large, students can choose from many clubs.
A new science building means more lab space for research projects.
With a modern cafeteria, students can enjoy healthy meals every day.
Our library is open late so that everyone can study before exams.
Free shuttle buses let students travel easily between the two campuses.
The academy offers each course online for students who live far away.
Students enjoy a lively social life thanks to our many sports teams.
At a big university you can choose from hundreds of different majors.

notes: card: 'opportunity for close interaction', 'Classes are small', 'small classes'; output promotes ' individual', ' attention', ' personalized'. Probe: 0.7-0.9 vs ~0.01 for other campus features. Quiet items advertise other school features.
